name: Lexicon Internet Services
summary: Melbourne dialup + hosting ISP (lexicon.net.au, principal Lex Giezen); had a Perth POP/service area (Cynosure 2000); absorbed CorpLink by 2004, absorbed into EFTel by 2006.

events.details: Founded ~1996 (about page Jan 1997: 'just about to celebrate its first birthday'; lexicon.net.au live by 21 Dec 1996).
